ruleDefinitions.name: Execution via stordiag.exe
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of stordiag.exe to execute schtasks.exe systeminfo.exe and fltmc.exe

sequences.query: (parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\stordiag\\\.exe$") AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\schtasks\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\systeminfo\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\fltmc\\\.exe$"))) AND  NOT ((parent_process_path = RGX("^c\\:\\\\windows\\\\system32\\\\") OR parent_process_path = RGX("^c\\:\\\\windows\\\\syswow64\\\\")))
